_note: Musical jokes, shown as ungraded multiple-choice questions in Test Yourself quizzes and the class game. Only "approved": true jokes are published (build_quizlist.py writes them to assets/jokes.js). topics = front-page section ids (build/apps.json) or "any"; optional units = quiz unit ids; w = the wrong choices.

jokes.q: What did the trombone player get on his orchestration test?
How do you get a violist to play tremolo?
jokes.a: Write the word “solo” on their music
w: Turn up the heat in the hall

jokes.q: How do you get a guitarist to stop playing?
w: Tell them the gig is over

jokes.q: How do you keep your violin from being stolen?
jokes.a: Keep it in a viola case
w: Lock it in the practice room

jokes.q: What's the range of an oboe?
jokes.a: About 20 yards, with a good arm
w: As far as the double reed allows

jokes.q: How do you make a trombone sound like a French horn?
jokes.a: Put your hand in the bell and miss a lot of notes

jokes.q: Why do bagpipers walk while they play?
jokes.a: To get away from the noise

jokes.q: What's the definition of a minor second?
How can you tell a drummer is at the door?
jokes.a: It's 20 minutes after you ordered the pizza

jokes.q: Why do violists stand outside people's houses for so long?
jokes.a: They can't find the key, and they don't know when to come in
w: Their case won't fit through the door

jokes.a: It keeps coming back to A
